sections.h2: 3. Check delivery times outside the UK
parts: Lusso Tan aims to dispatch orders within 3 days. Delivery to Ireland costs €5, and Europe £25 with 5 to 7 days in transit. Orders to the USA and Canada take about 7 days from dispatch, and to Australia and New Zealand 7 to 10 days. You'll see the cost for your country at checkout.
